Subject Property Positioning

1 bed / 1 bath entire-home short-term rental. The comp set prioritizes nearby properties with similar bedroom count, bath count, and guest capacity within Wilmington.

Market Read

The broader Wilmington STR market averages 47% occupancy and $169.90 ADR across roughly 435 active listings, generating an average annual revenue of $21,352 per property. The subject property's ADR of $156.80 is competitive and close to market average, but its 31.8% annual occupancy sits 15 points below the market norm — meaning the pricing strategy is sound, but availability and booking friction are the primary drag on total revenue. Closing that occupancy gap is the single biggest lever to outperform the Wilmington market average.

Performance Analytics · Market Occupancy by Month

Seasonal performance patterns

Market occupancy across the calendar year, used to time rate strategy between peak and shoulder windows.

Peak SeasonMay to Aug

Wilmington occupancy peaks during May to Aug, ranging from 51% to 59%. Premium ADR is achievable in this window; protect rate and avoid early-bird discounting that erodes peak revenue.

Shoulder SeasonSep to Apr

Occupancy softens during Sep to Apr, ranging from 36% to 49%. Strategic amenity positioning, longer-stay incentives, and gap-night pricing can lift shoulder-season occupancy meaningfully.
